company.shortDescription: Litmus develops hiring software that evaluate software engineering candidates through contextual, work-based technical assessments.
company.description: Litmus develops hiring software that helps organizations evaluate software engineering candidates through contextual, work-based technical assessments. The platform enables employers to create engineering tasks based on their own codebase, job requirements, and development workflows instead of relying solely on traditional coding interviews. It supports asynchronous candidate evaluations and provides insights into how candidates approach, build, and complete technical work. The platform is designed to integrate AI-assisted development into the assessment process while measuring technical execution and problem-solving in a work-relevant environment. Litmus serves organizations seeking to assess engineering candidates using practical, job-related tasks as part of their hiring process.
